reuse.why: Extends the existing link.assertBankAccountNotLinked guard that all six provider link functions already call before any write or sync.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once in the shared guard; nothing is repeated per provider.

placement.why: Correct module (link.ts preconditions), but the closed-account rule is folded into a guard named for the one-link-per-bank rule; the doc comment is updated, the name is not.

scope.why: A guard addition plus focused integration tests for the three required behaviours.

maintainability.why: Covers every path from one place and is well tested; the guard's name now understates what it asserts.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, called by all six link* functions in accounts/app.ts
